gloss: bare skin; scalp; natural texture; bare ground

definitions.explanation: The natural, uncovered state of one's skin, especially the face without makeup or the body without clothing.
The skin of the head, especially when visible through thinning hair.

definitions.gloss: natural surface; bare ground; underlying texture
definitions.explanation: The natural surface of materials like wood, stone, or the ground when exposed, without paint, covering, or vegetation.

notes:
A versatile word describing any natural, exposed surface. The scalp sense is particularly common in hair care and beauty products.

FORMS:
{地|じ} (ground, base, natural) + ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin, surface)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地肌|じはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: the bare surface/scalp is visible
- {地肌|じはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やさしい: gentle on the skin/scalp
- {地肌|じはだ}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: scalp/skin care
- {地肌|じはだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to make use of the natural texture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素肌|すはだ}→素肌：20256_suhada⟧: bare skin (especially face/body without makeup) — overlaps with sense 1 but more commonly used for beauty contexts
- {頭皮|とうひ}: scalp — medical/clinical term, while {地肌|じはだ} is everyday language
- {地|じ}: the base, natural state — broader meaning
